chapter: Hollywood life and the musicians' union
title: Buying a house in Hollywood and his marriages
summary: He rented and bought houses in Hollywood in 1943-45, and gave one to his second wife in the divorce.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yes. Before we go in to some of your film work, which we must do of course ... not to make it definitively complete, but just to give some idea of it, I want to ask you a couple of questions about matters dealing with musicians in their professional life and your own personal life, rather than strictly musical matters.

Okay. When did you first base yourself in Hollywood? You were there in '43 -- when did you use Hollywood as a personal place for you to live, out of which you would work? Do you remember when that was?

Well, I rented a house in Hollywood in 1943, then in 1944, I bought a house -- then in 1945, the house that I had bought, I gave to my ex-wife, in the divorce settlement, and I bought another house in Hollywood -- this was in 1945. And I guess from that point on, I thought of, considered, my home base.
Because the house that I had prior to that I hardly ever lived in. I wasn't there.
So she was welcome to it all.
Which wife was this, may I ask?
And is that the wife with whom you had your daughter?
No. No, that was the wife ...
Mary was the mother of Joyce.
And Inez was the mother of Barbara, who is my stepdaughter, Barbara, -- stepdaughter, because I was not her father.
